description: This is the main service class for the Connectivity component, which initializes and runs the Connectivity service, setting up configuration and actor system within an Akka framework.

classes.name: ConnectivityService
classes.description: Main entry point class for the Connectivity service, extending DittoService to initialize and manage the connectivity actor system.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Static method to start the Connectivity service. Creates an instance and waits for termination.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificConfig
methods.description: Provides the service-specific configuration by converting the general ScopedConfig to ConnectivityConfig.

methods.name: getMainRootActorProps
methods.description: Provides Akka Props for the main root actor, using connectivity configuration and pub/sub mediator.
